family.name: Carrion swarms
family.lore: The crows of the Moor learned to follow the plague carts. They have not forgotten the way.

monsters.name: Carrion Murder
monsters.desc: A murder of grave-crows that hunts as one ragged thing, and quarrels over what it catches.
monsters.answer: Strike the whole cloud at once. When it settles on a corpse, raise, burn or spend the body before it eats.
